name: Overload Wild Herb
tooltip:
Overload Wild Herb
5 yd range
5.3 sec cast
The lands of Zul'Aman teem with wild nature magic connected with the Loa themselves. By overloading a Wild herb, the herbalist may challenge an Avatar of Halazzi, the Lynx Loa, in combat. Success in this trial results in a temporary but keen increase to Perception.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
